name: Copper
source: FRED PCOPPUSDM (monthly global) and Gold API (daily snapshots)
conversion: USD per metric ton / 2204.6226218 = USD per avoirdupois pound
attribution: Monthly copper: FRED PCOPPUSDM (IMF global price, USD per metric ton) converted to USD per pound. Daily last prices: Gold API. These are different series — the monthly average is not a daily close and is not used for day change.
frequency_note: Points tagged grain=monthly are first-of-month IMF global averages (latest in this file: September 2026, 14473.05590909091 USD/mt ≈ 6.5649 USD/lb). Points tagged grain=daily are Gold API last-price snapshots. Day-over-day change uses consecutive daily snapshots only.
